dedupe_keys.name: hydrological yearbook of the panama canal watershed anuario hidrologico 2024 acp

description: The Panama Canal Authority publishes a hydrological yearbook for the Panama Canal watershed; the 2024 edition, issued in March 2025, is a 107-page PDF from the operational hydrology team of the hydrometeorology division. The foreword explains that the Authority is responsible for the water of the watershed, used for the water supply of Panama City, Colón and surrounding areas, for navigation and the operation of the Canal, and for hydropower, farming, industry and other uses. The yearbook gives daily, monthly and annual statistics of levels and flows of the main rivers of the watershed and their inflows to the Gatún and Alhajuela reservoirs, with station chapters for Chico on the Chagres, Candelaria on the Pequení, Peluca on the Boquerón, Ciento on the Gatún, El Chorro on the Trinidad, Los Cañones on the Cirí Grande, Caño Quebrado Abajo and Guarumal on the Indio Este, and suspended sediment concentrations from the sediment sampling programme. The foreword notes that the first hydrological records of the watershed date from the 1870s. Access is free as a PDF; no licence is stated. Caveats: the data is in tables in a PDF, not a download, and it is in Spanish. Coverage is the Panama Canal watershed. It supports drought and flood hazard exposure analysis for canal operations, reservoirs and urban water supply; related records are the Icelandic hydrometric network and the INAMHI hydrometeorological yearbooks.
